name: Weighted Donkey Calf Raise
steps: Stand facing a sturdy chair with feet hip-width apart and hinge forward to brace both hands on its back.
Have a partner place the plate across the back of your pelvis and steady it throughout the movement.
Keep your knees softly extended and lift both heels by pressing through your forefeet.
Lower your heels slowly and have the partner remove the plate before you stand upright.
tips: Keep the plate clear of your lower spine and stop if it shifts.
Push evenly through both forefeet while keeping your knees and hips steady.
